Interesting! Each event has only one station pick. This is unusual for microseismic monitoring where we typically have multiple stations recording each event. However, looking at the pattern, I notice that stations S0, S1, S2, S3, S4 appear in a repeating sequence: S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, S0, S1. This suggests we might have 12 events total, with each event recorded at a different station in a round-robin fashion.
